title: Balikpapan, East Kalimantan — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Balikpapan, East Kalimantan: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Balikpapan is a city in East Kalimantan with a population of 700,000. A major oil and gas hub on Borneo, known for its beautiful beaches, the Balikpapan Bay, and as the gateway to Indonesia’s new capital Nusantara. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
